finish_line: Guard only: the existing test suite passes on the box; security headers stay in parity between scripts/security-headers.js, render.yaml and _headers (tests/security-headers.test.mjs); every page in pages/ has its dist/<slug>/index.html; no internal link, anchor or asset in the built site is broken (a link test exists and has a negative control); no inline script or on*= handler exists; the em dash, emoji and locked hero bookend rules are enforced by tests. No taste or design change of any kind.

units.title: Baseline: run bun run test on the box and record the real node --test verdict lines (tests/ has 10 files; services/api/test too); record bun run build and bun run validate verdicts
units.source: AGENTS.md:68-73; package.json scripts test, build, validate
units.notes: Report anything that fails as a finding; do not weaken a test.

units.title: Security headers parity: scripts/security-headers.js versus render.yaml versus _headers; confirm tests/security-headers.test.mjs passes and add a negative control (a planted header drift turns it red)
units.notes: A header change itself is protected: report, do not edit.

units.title: Broken-link test: a new tests/links.test.mjs that walks dist/ and fails on any internal href, src, anchor or asset that does not resolve (the only link test today covers llms.txt). Internal only, no network. Negative control with a planted dead link in a fixture
units.notes: External links are listed in the report, never fetched.

units.title: Fix any broken href found by G02 in pages/ or markdown/ (href text only), or report it if the fix needs a content decision
Inline-script guard: no inline <script> block and no on*= handler in pages/, markdown/ or built dist (the CSP has no unsafe-inline for scripts); test with a negative control
Page-to-dist coverage: every pages/ slug has dist/<slug>/index.html and a markdown companion; confirm tests/artifacts.test.mjs:253 and :281 pass, and add a negative control
Hard-rule scans as tests: zero em dashes and zero emojis in pages/, markdown/, css/, js/ and docs (no dedicated test exists today); negative control with a planted em dash
units.notes: Existing em dashes in the tree are findings for Jay, not edits.

units.title: Locked hero bookends: a test that the homepage still opens 'LOOKING FOR JAY?' and closes 'Ahhhh, Just Jay!' (no test covers this today)
units.notes: Test only; the middle words are Jay's.

units.title: Theme-ramp guard: light-theme rules never use the turquoise ramp (#00b8cc) and dark-theme rules never use the blue ramp (#2196f3) outside the token definitions. Mechanical test, report-only on any hit
units.notes: Taste-adjacent: test and report, never recolour.

units.title: Clean-build rule: confirm scripts/validate.js fails when a source is newer than dist/build-info.json, with a negative control
